Anna (Sales): Quick sync for AtlasBank POC. 3-week pilot ask, VPC-only, customer-managed keys, 20k DAU, avg 2 calls/day, avg 80 tokens, spikes 1k RPS for marketing push. Need concrete SOW bullets, capacity plan, and cost range.
Ben (AE): Budget conversation: they prefer <$20k for pilot.
Noor (SE): Ballpark token math: 20k * 2 * 80 = 3,200,000 tokens/day -> ~96M tokens/month. For pilot (3 weeks) ~672M? wait re-check: 3.2M/day * 21 = 67.2M tokens.
Marco (Infra): Required sustained throughput baseline: 200 RPS -> 200*80=16k tok/s. Spikes 1k RPS -> 80k tok/s.
Noor (SE): Typical throughput by GPU: T4=400 tok/s, V100=2k tok/s, H100=7k tok/s. For 16k tok/s => ~8 V100s or ~3 H100s. For spikes (80k tok/s) => ~40 V100s or ~12 H100s (ephemeral).
Lina (Security): Confirming: no outbound logs, CMK with key policy specifying redwood role and customer account, audit logs in their S3 180 days.
Noor (SE): Cost sketch: H100 spot pricing varies; reserved 1 H100 24/7 + ephemeral H100 for bursts is expensive. Suggest reserved 2 V100 equivalents 12h/day + autoscale V100 spot for spikes + aggressive caching. Estimated infra cost for 3 weeks ~$14-18k, platform & token fees ~$3-6k -> total $17-24k.
Anna (Sales): That's slightly over their preference. Any lower-cost mitigations?
Noor (SE): Lower-cost mitigations: heavier sampling (show 10% traffic first), aggressive prefix caching, apply a prefilter classifier on CPU to short-circuit low-value queries (saves tokens), or use a partly-hosted approach for marketing push. Recommend: staged ramp starting 10% traffic, expand if quality ok.
Marco (Infra): Runbook timelines: VPC peering & KMS setup 2-4 business days, reserved infra provisioning 1-2 days, autoscale + canary 3 days.
Noor (SE): Suggested SOW success criteria:
1) p95 latency < 600ms during 10% staged traffic week.
2) Error rate < 1.5% during pilot.
3) Quality: >= 90% on 200-prompt eval set, with 25 manual checks.
4) Cost cap: pilot <= $20k for conservative offering.
5) Security: VPC + CMK + 180-day audit logs validated.
Ben (AE): I'll frame a "cost-conservative" and "performance" tier in the proposal.
OpsBot: provisioning_task created: poc-alloc-8819 status=pending_network
Anna (Sales): I'll ask the customer if they'd accept the staged 10% approach. Need questionnaire answers in 48 hours.
Marco (Infra): Also flag: if they require guaranteed <400ms p95, we need full H100 reserved and that doubles cost.
Anna (Sales): Noted. Will update once customer replies. :raised_hands:
